title: Manager-loop worker report
description: The final report of one dispatched worker, for codex exec --output-schema. Every key is required; use an empty array when a list has nothing to say.

pr.description: The pull request number the worker opened or updated.

head_sha.description: The full SHA of the branch head the report describes.

gates.description: Each mechanical gate the card names, with the last line it printed.

command.description: The gate command, exactly as run.

result_line.description: The command's last output line, quoted verbatim.

evidence.description: Paths or links that show the acceptance criteria hold.

revert_checks.description: One line per fix: the check that failed when the fix was reverted.

deviations.description: Each departure from the card, with the reason.

questions.description: Questions for the lead that the card did not answer.

patch_notes.description: Notes for owners of other files or cards that this work touches.
